thesis: HBL has a real Kavach moat (limited RDSO-approved vendors; CARE notes 6,000 locos fitted, ~7,300 in progress, 21,800 route-km taken up), and a CARE upgrade to AA-. But the latest reported quarter shows no inflection: revenue +6% YoY, EBITDA -23.5%, margin 23.0% (-8.9pt), PAT -24%, with 25.9x TTM P/E on a peak-ish FY26 base. The only recent order (Rs31.49cr) is tiny. Wait for order inflow and margin stabilisation.
